verses.1: In the year of Tarshana Ashdoda, Sargon, king of Assyria, sent him there. He fought against Ashdoda, and he was captured.
verses.2: On that day, the LORD spoke through Yeshua ben Amos. He said to him, “Open your sackcloth and put it off from you. Your feet will be able to walk on dry ground again.” And so it happened. Arum went away, and he was freed from his troubles.
verses.3: And Jehovah said that when His servant Yeshua went away, he suffered many hardships and hardships for three years. He also suffered during those times in Egypt and in Kush.
verses.4: Thus, the king of Assyria will treat the captives from Egypt in a cruel manner. He will also expose the young and old, both men and women, to the shame and humiliation that only the people of Egypt can endure.
verses.5: And they were cursed and punished by God from among the people of Egypt. They were made to suffer greatly.
verses.6: And the king said, “On this day, look at how we are trapped here. We were sent there to help us escape from the king of Assyria. But how can we get out of this situation?”
